findings.description: API key stored as plain String instead of SecureString (DPS-8 SEC-006 violation)
findings.recommendation: Change 'private let apiKey: String' to 'private let secureAPIKey: SecureString' and use withSecureAccess pattern like AssemblyAIBackend

findings.description: init accepts API key as plain String parameter (DPS-8 SEC-006 violation)
findings.recommendation: Change init parameter to accept SecureString or wrap immediately: 'self.secureAPIKey = SecureString(apiKey)'

findings.description: URL string concatenation without encoding - vulnerable to URL injection (DPS-8 SEC-004 violation)
findings.recommendation: Use URLComponents or SecureURLConstruction.url(baseURL:appendingPathComponents:) with proper path encoding instead of string concatenation

findings.description: Hardcoded URL with force unwrap anti-pattern (URL(string:)!)
findings.recommendation: Use SecureURLConstruction pattern or at minimum handle URL creation failure gracefully instead of force unwrap

findings.recommendation: Use SecureURLConstruction pattern or at minimum handle URL creation failure gracefully instead of force unwrap

findings.description: URL created from external response data without validation (urlString from JSON response)
findings.recommendation: Validate URL scheme (https only) and host before using URLs from external sources

findings.description: URL created from external response data without validation (upload_url from JSON)
findings.recommendation: Validate URL scheme (https only) and host (.assemblyai.com) before using URLs from external sources

findings.description: Function accepts API key as plain String parameter (DPS-8 SEC-006 violation)

findings.description: API key set directly in HTTP header from plain String storage
